answer: Three witnesses from branches sharing no parent must each stake anchor before a voyage registers on the terrace; a stake backs one voyage per epoch and is slashed whole if that voyage is contradicted, so a vouch is a spend, not a signature. Disjointness makes the price per head scale with branches walked, not clones: k fakes need 3k witness slots no two sharing a parent, and each branch supplies a capped number, so the thousandth voyage must reach branches already exhausted and burn 3k units of anchor. It breaks if witnesses rent slots or branches merge.
